title: Decoding What iOS Location Services Send to Apple: An LLM Is an Unreliable Analyst but a Useful Toolmaker
abstract: arXiv:2610.21597v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reverse engineering the data formats used by mobile software is skilled and slow, and using AI to assist with it is attractive. We evaluate this for the protobuf messages that an iPhone sends to Apple's location services. Working from Apple's binaries, we use two frontier models (Claude Opus 4.8, Codex GPT Sol 5.6) to reconstruct the schemas of protobufs observed in network traffic. The great majority of the schemas contain substantial errors, and these are hard to detect because the schemas are internally consistent. Direct AI use is therefore unsuitable for forensic and privacy analysis. AI can, however, write reliable analysis tools when their output can be validated. We use Claude to write a Python tool, Extractor, that reliably recovers protobuf schemas from Apple binaries. We validate it against binaries compiled from schemas with known answers, previously published schemas, and network measurements. We demonstrate the use of Ext

translated_title: 解码iOS定位服务发送给苹果的数据：大语言模型是不可靠的分析师，但却是实用的工具制造者
translated_abstract: 逆向工程移动软件所使用的数据格式是一项需要专业技能且耗时的工作，因此利用AI辅助这项工作颇具吸引力。我们对iPhone发送给苹果定位服务的protobuf消息进行了评估。基于苹果的二进制文件，我们使用两个前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.8和Codex GPT Sol 5.6）来重建网络流量中观察到的protobuf模式。绝大多数重建的模式包含大量错误，且由于这些模式在内部是自洽的，这些错误很难被检测出来。因此，直接使用AI不适合用于取证和隐私分析。然而，当所编写工具的输出可以被验证时，AI能够编写出可靠的分析工具。我们使用Claude编写了一个Python工具——Extractor，它能够可靠地从苹果二进制文件中恢复protobuf模式。我们通过与由已知答案模式编译的二进制文件、先前已发表的模式以及网络测量数据进行对比，对该工具进行了验证。我们展示了Ext（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究发现大语言模型直接重建iOS定位服务protobuf模式时错误率高且因模式自洽而难以察觉，不适合取证与隐私分析，但让AI编写输出可验证的Python工具Extractor，则能可靠地从苹果二进制文件中恢复protobuf模式。
en_tdlr: LLMs directly reconstructing iOS location services protobuf schemas produce substantial, hard-to-detect errors unsuitable for forensic analysis, but an AI-written Python tool (Extractor) with validatable output reliably recovers protobuf schemas from Apple binaries.
